judge_notes.opus5: The sell-side bar is mechanical: Q2 guided $114-118m and printed $189.6m (+63% over the midpoint) with the FY raised $166m, and Q3 consensus of $163-168m still sits within a few million of the $160-164m guide while the Q1/Q2 run-rate is ~$190m, so a run-rate print is ~+13% on revenue plus an automatic FY raise, the exact shape that bought +32% and +21%. Shrunk hard because a 46% run since the last print, an all-time high 13% above the average target and put/call OI of 0.02 mean the buy side is already there.
judge_notes.opus55: The company's own documents show a guide set roughly 60% below outcomes, a Q3 guide implying -15% sequential and consensus anchored to it (i0/i1); a 46% post-print run (i2) is the main offset.
judge_notes.sonnet55: Q3 revenue guide implies a 15% q/q drop from $189.6m while two prior quarters beat guide by 60%+ and consensus sits on the guide; tempered by a 46% run, JPM valuation downgrade and put skew.
judge_notes.fable51: The Q3 guide implies a 15% sequential revenue drop after two quarters beaten by 60%+ with consensus still anchored a few million above the guide (i0, i1) on a three-for-three up-reaction name with shorts tripled (i3); the 46% post-print run and the whisper (i2) are the bar and keep p_up short of the primary-document tier.
